title: Halo footer
description: A black rounded panel inset from the page edge: link columns with large headings on the left, an outlined and an orange button at the top right, a wide art strip across the middle and a thin legal row at the bottom. Columns wrap to two across on phones.
notes: black panel in any theme: it uses the dark tokens
the art strip is a media slot; empty it is a faint graphite glow
